scope_limits: One calling thread; host Python and instrumented native code. Device kernels, other threads and uninstrumented library internals are not observed.
Paths mode preserves observed stack paths, branches and counts, not per-invocation order or timestamps.
Unknown/macro-generated C++ declarations remain unresolved; mapping is not 100 percent.
All resolvable Python roots from the shared documentation ledger are enabled for each test. C++ ledger entries are not independently bound as API roots; instrumented native descendants are collected.
Five NPU methods fail in both variants; captures cover the executed prefix. Two Module.to_empty cases fail at Module.to message assertion before reaching to_empty.
Trace collection is separate from the runtime timing results.
